** *
Manisha Batra, J (Oral):-

The present petition has been filed by the petitioner seeking grant of regular bail in case bearing FIR No. 723 dated 01.08.2017 registered under Sections 406 and 420 of IPC at Police Station City Hisar, District Hisar, Haryana.

2. Brief facts of the case relevant for the purpose of disposal of this petition are that the aforementioned FIR had been registered on complaint lodged by the complainant-Bishambar Dass,
on the allegations that the accused Ashish, Kapil Sharma and Barkha Bhutani had formed four co-operative societies and represented them as Secretaries of those societies.

They had induced the complainant and several other public persons to deposit their money with the societies run by them by representing that the money so deposited would fetch annual compound interest at the rate of 1 of 4 Neutral Citation No:=2024:PHHC:107607 12% to 15% and the deposits would be completely safe, as they were to be lent to banks or government employees.
Huge amount of money deposited by the members of the society had been misused by the above named accused by purchasing Benami properties.
They had criminally misappropriated the money so deposited, thereby rendering the societies as bankrupt.

The money so deposited by the complainant and other depositors had not Rajesh Kumar vs State Of Haryana on 12 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/69085919/
1 been returned and therefore, prayer had been made for taking action in the matter.

sentences.text: SIT was constituted to investigate the matter.
The above named accused were joined into investigation and presently, they are on bail.

The petitioner was nominated as an accused on the allegations that he had prepared false audit report to cause benefit to the other co-accused and had facilitated usurpation of the funds of the co-operative societies with malafide.
The petitioner was arrested on 06.06.2024.
Investigation has since been completed.
3. The present petition has been filed by the petitioner on the grounds and it is argued by his counsel that he has been falsely implicated in this case.
He was neither named in the FIR nor any specific role had been attributed to him.
He was an auditor of the society and had prepared audit report in the year 2010-11 showing several anomalies in the accounts of the co-operative societies.
The entire case is based on documentary evidence.
He did not derive any financial benefit.
Investigation has been completed and challan stands presented.
His further incarceration would not serve any useful purpose.
Trial is likely to take time.

He has been extended benefit of bail in case bearing FIR No.
294 dated 09.04.2016 registered against him at 2 of 4 Neutral Citation No:=2024:PHHC:107607 Police Station City Hisar.

entities.text: Neutral Citation No:=2024:PHHC:107607 Police Station City Hisar
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: With these broad submissions, it is urged that the petitioner deserves to be released on bail.
4. Status report has been filed by respondent-AAG, Haryana.

It is argued by learned AAG, Haryana that there are serious allegations against the petitioner as during the further investigation of the case, it has been revealed that petitioner in collusion with the co-accused and by misusing his position, had extended unjust benefits to the co-accused by fake and illegal notice to the lenders,
legally reinstating the societies, releasing properties relating to co-accused, by violating orders of Deputy Registrar, creating list of fake properties and by not sealing the bank accounts of the co-accused.
He does not have clean antecedents as two more cases of similar nature have been registered against him.
There is nothing to show that there would be any undue delay in conclusion of the trial.
Therefore, it is urged that the petition does not deserve to be allowed.
5. I have heard learned counsel for the petitioner as well as learned State counsel at considerable length and have gone through the record carefully.

6. The petitioner was not named in the FIR, however, he has been nominated as an accused on the allegations that in connivance with the co- accused and to cause undue advantage to them, he had not conducted audit as per rules and had had committed certain acts of omissions and commissions.
The petitioner is in custody since 06.06.2024.
Investigation stands concluded.
Trial is likely to take time.
The entire case is based upon documentary evidence.
Subject offences are triable by Magistrate.
In my 3 of 4 Neutral Citation No:=2024:PHHC:107607 considered opinion, his further incarceration would be of no gain.

In view of the above discussed facts and circumstances of the case, but without meaning to make any comment on the merits thereof, I am of the considered opinion that the petition deserves to be allowed.

Hence, the same is allowed and the petitioner is ordered to be released on bail subject to his furnishing personal/surety bonds to the satisfaction of the Chief Judicial Magistrate/ Duty Magistrate concerned.
